department: Government of Andhra Pradesh (welfare departments, via Jnanabhumi portal)
summary: Andhra Pradesh state portal for pre-matric and post-matric scholarships, student registration, fee reimbursement and fund release. Covers SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority, Kapu and differently abled students.

eligibility.income_limit_note: Varies by category. Confirm on the portal.

types: Tuition fee reimbursement (paid to the college)
Maintenance amount for food and lodging (paid to the student)
benefits.amounts_note: Amounts differ across sources (from about Rs 2,000 to Rs 80,000 a year). Do not show a figure until confirmed.

documents.name: Kutumba ID
documents.why: The portal uses it to check residency, caste and family income automatically

documents.name: Income certificate
documents.why: Proves family income is under the limit

documents.name: Aadhaar-linked bank account
documents.why: Allowances are paid by direct transfer to the student
documents.if_missing: Open an account and link it to Aadhaar

documents.name: SATS ID (if asked)
documents.why: One login option on the portal

steps: Create an account or log in with your SATS ID or Aadhaar
Enter your details; Kutumba ID checks residency, caste and income
Enter the digital caste certificate details
Complete biometric authentication at your college
Track status under 'Print Application Status' using your Aadhaar or application ID

dates.deadline_note: Sources conflict: some say 31/10/2026, another says the 2025-26 cycle closed 28/02/2026 and 2026-27 opens soon. Confirm on the portal.

helpline.note: Sources list different numbers (1902, 0863-2340142, 08645-274025). Confirm on the portal before showing any.

sources: indiascholarships.in (AP scholarship pages), unofficial and internally inconsistent

open_items: whether NSP registration is also needed
